nom: DHC Water Friendly Face Cleansing Oil

avis.texte: I've really tried to make this product work for me, but it really doesn't. It doesn't remove waterproof mascara easily; I really had to scrub to remove it all, and even then there was still some mascara left on my eyelashes. It stung my eyes as well. The only benefit I see to this cleansing oil is that it doesn't leave a residue. That's not even really a problem though, as I double cleanse anyway.

As it's water-friendly, it is basically water itself. Hard to clean your face when it doesn't stay in your hands to make it to your face. I felt like I had to go back to get more because it would just run off between my fingers. I'm unsure if it actually even works well seeing as most of the product didn't make it to my face.

I've cycled through several various korean and japanese cleansing oils ever since my first love, hadalabo gokyujun, became harder and harder to come by. Dare I say… I like this better. It's a wonderful texture, rinses clean (though i do double cleanse), and it really deep cleans the pores. My skin looks clear and has been less dry! Will definitely repurchase.

I used another cleansing oil before this and it left a thick film that was impossible to wash off without a face towel. This DHC cleansers cleaned so well and washed away the makeup!! Its a great first step for a double cleanse and I will be repurchasing for the foreseeable future!
I love this product so much! I use it everyday as an esthetician and love how it removes my makeup seamlessly without clogging my pores or irritating my sensitive eyes. A must buy!
I love this! It removes makeup well without making your face feel greasy, and it feels lightweight. Overall, this performs better than the expensive makeup removers I've tried.

I prefer a cleansing oil now that I am nearing my 40s and acne is no longer an issue. Now I feel like I can't hydrate enough, and tend to stay away from anything mattifying or drying. At the same time, I always struggle to find a cleanser that will remove my tubing mascara efficiently. This one does it, but you have to be patient and continue to gently rub longer than you hope/want to. I typically double-cleanse when using this product, but that's just how I roll. I think it's a good product, especially for the price.

Ive been looking for a good make up remover that wouldnt be harsh on my skin and takes of my make up in one try, this one does just that. I use colorpops eyeliner which has been difficult to take off with other removers, wipes and butters, but this one took it off realky easily!!

I was not sure about this to be honest but OMGOSH , I wet my hand, two pumps and I rub my hands together and apply all over my face. Takes off my make up. Does not sud up and you will need to use eye make remover first. This leaves my face smooth and refreshed. Not oily at all. A must have!!
